So I decided to do this little project because

  1. I hadn't done one in a while.
  2. It's fun.
  3. Every white person needs a personal copy of Mein Kamf.

Start off by printing your preferred purchased .pdf copy, I chose the Ford translation. Just print it as a booklet so that every sheet has 4 consecutive pages on it, not one single fold for the entire document. Depending on the software used you might have the option of offsetting the pages so they don't nest too close to the spine, go for it.

Now wash your hands and start folding, precisely !

The next step consists in stacking the folded pages, squaring & evening them off and then clamping them together. Just don't clamp all the way down yet, leave some spring in the pages.

This time around I used clear Nigger Glue, it's pretty lazy so it doesn't cure hard, it stays rubbery & is tacky as fuck. Put some electric tape on the edge so it doesn't grab on too hard. Now clamp it down good.

Then I clamped them all together, drilled 1/16" holes through the spine & stiched it with copper wire. Then another layer of glue over it all. Might be able to skip this step with this adhesive though, it was part of my old process.

Optional - Once it was dry, I reclamped everything together & used a flap disc on an angle grinder to smooth out the edges & burn them a bit.

I then glued a sheet of thick paper to the stainless steel cover with the rubber contact cement, the other half became the first blank page.

All that was left to do at this point was glue the "leather hinge" to the spine & stainless covers.

Side view of the grinded edges... I had to use a freaking power tool somewhere !

And the finished product.

It will make a beautiful night table piece.

Tools & supplies required. + a drill. Stainless sheets you can get at your local welding shop for aboot 15-20$, get 20 or 22ga.
